text: This game is such a scam if you plan on getting it for your little one don't its graphics are extremely poor most images or backgrounds are of poorly rendered copy pictures off of Google most of the game cost money it gives you three options that are free and the rest including parental settings cost you to pay for premium which cost R 149.99 a month which is a scam based off of how utterly poor the game looks if I could give this 0 stars I would Especially because pocoyo is such a large title I

I don't like these kind of series. Because, my 5 and 2 year old sons are mad at you of what you've been done. I am on an Samsung device and on the Talking Pocoyo 2 and run and fun, it has a Pocoyo House logo and it says to download the Pocoyo House from Play store. Please change it to be normal app without the Pocoyo House logo. Or else, You and the Pocoyo team Will be grounded.

The app is terrible. While I do love the show so much because I watched it when I was a baby, I do not like this app. Its terrible because every feature costs money. And not only that but some other Pocoyo apps such as Pocoyo Alphabet & Pocoyo Run & Fun, need to be paid as a monthly subscription in order to use them, So either make some of the features free, or I will never install this app again. If I was able to give this app 0 stars, I would.
